description: Gold Standard Ground Truth Benchmark for Industrial FPD Manufacturing Incident Mining

meta.title: M2 Aluminum Corrosion and Line Open Defect in Contact Holes

symptom.description: Lighting test reports Data dark line / open circuit; AOI reports AZ99 M2 corrosion defects exceeding 1000 pcs per plate, concentrated at the edge of ILD contact holes on Poly left side.

disputes.hypothesis: Suspects DET dry etch chamber moisture leakage or Photo PR thickness insufficient.
Coating thickness and bake temperature are strictly within POR; resist etch resistance margin is nominal.
No chamber-to-chamber difference observed; issue only explodes on new 5.99 inch product layout.

validation_probe.method: Worst-case layout tolerance stack budget comparison between legacy protected designs and new zero-margin products.

ground_truth_physics.mechanism: DRC tolerance stack breakdown: ILD via etch CD 2.5±0.7μm, M2 Photo CD 2.5±0.6μm, combined with stepper overlay shift ±0.8μm. Under worst-case alignment, M2 fails to enclose the ILD via completely. The exposed aluminum sidewall is directly bombarded by chlorine gases (Cl2/BCl3) during dry etch, producing hygroscopic AlCl3 trapped in micro-crevices. Upon ambient humidity contact, autocatalytic electrochemical corrosion occurs: AlCl3 + 3H2O -> Al(OH)3 + 3HCl, eroding the metal line.

pr_vs_physics_decoupling.external_8d_narrative: Attributed to machine PM cycle fluctuation and temporary micro-particle contamination; resolved via in-situ passivated pump-down purge to prevent batch containment.
pr_vs_physics_decoupling.internal_ground_truth: Layout DRC enclosure failure leading to dry etch Cl2 chemical attack and moisture-induced corrosion.

pca_solution.action: Tape-out mask revision enforcing unilateral 1.5μm sizing out enclosure of M2 over ILD vias; strictly enforce dry etch to wet strip Q-Time < 4 hours.

meta.title: ITO2 Line Width Step Jump Caused by Photoresist Photospeed Shift

symptom.description: All exposure steppers across multiple lines show sudden upward step shift in ITO2 CD mean value (+0.12μm) exceeding specification upper control limit.

disputes.hypothesis: Suspected stepper illuminance sensor degradation or Track TMAH developer concentration decay.
Correlated across all steppers simultaneously regardless of developer lot; suspected PR raw chemical batch shift.

validation_probe.method: Align lot timing with PR batch changeover and perform photospeed (Eth) pulse sensitivity test on standard dummy substrates.

ground_truth_physics.mechanism: PR supplier (Merck AZ SR-210) adjusted internal PAC blend ratio from 60.4:39.6 to 59.5:40.5 to satisfy internal synthesis CPK without prior notification. The photospeed Eth shifted from 23.5mJ to 25.0mJ (+1.5mJ/cm2), slowing down the positive photoresist response and causing incomplete photochemical cleavage under standard POR dose, leaving broader residual lines.
ground_truth_physics.chemical_reaction: PAC photoactive compound cleavage kinetics delta

pr_vs_physics_decoupling.external_8d_narrative: Standard seasonal environmental temperature/humidity compensation and Track bake plate thermal tuning.
pr_vs_physics_decoupling.internal_ground_truth: Supplier unannounced PR PAC ratio modification altering photochemical cleavage threshold Eth.

pca_solution.action: Implement incoming QA pulse Eth testing checkpoint for every incoming PR batch; apply feedforward exposure dose offset +1.2mJ for affected batches.

dfm_rule.name: Raw Material Batch Feedforward Offset Rule

meta.title: PVD ITO Thickness Fluctuation Induced Optical Standing Wave CD Drift

symptom.description: After PVD ITO deposition, ADI inspection measures periodic 0.1μm CD fluctuation across glass substrate; steppers report nominal dose and focus.

disputes.hypothesis: Suspects PVD sputtering thickness uniformity failure.
ITO film thickness is within 450±25Å spec; argues photolithography exposure dose fluctuates.

validation_probe.method: Optical swing curve simulation and multi-angle ellipsometer reflection spectral analysis.

ground_truth_physics.mechanism: Transparent ITO thin film (refractive index n ≈ 2.0) creates optical standing wave multi-beam interference under 365nm i-line exposure. The optical path difference OPD = 2 * n * d matches the destructive interference condition. A slight 200Å thickness change shifts the interference phase by 90 degrees, modulating the effective light dose coupled into the photoresist by 10-15%, which directly manifests as a 0.1μm pseudo-exposure CD drift.
ground_truth_physics.chemical_reaction: Multi-beam optical path difference OPD = 2 * n * d * cos(theta)

pr_vs_physics_decoupling.external_8d_narrative: Coating speed optimization and exposure lamp calibration.
pr_vs_physics_decoupling.internal_ground_truth: Thin-film optical interference phase swing amplifying PVD 200Å thickness tolerance into downstream CD variation.

pca_solution.action: Lock PVD target thickness strictly at the extrema (flat derivative dE/dd ≈ 0) of the optical swing curve; integrate anti-reflective bottom coating (BARC) on critical layers.

dfm_rule.name: Optical Swing Curve Extremum Target Rule
dfm_rule.formula: d_target = k * (lambda / (4 * n)), where k is odd integer for destructive node
